Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Price
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 129 as introduced will increase the salary expenses of the Lee County Board of Registrars, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated maximum of $16,000 annually. This act could also increase the mileage, travel, and other expenses reimbursed to the board from the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of additional meeting days and the number of members in attendance.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
